_description: Incident scenario for Lab 7. 'actions' is the catalog of possible response steps; 'playbooks' are ordered lists of action ids to grade. volatility_rank follows RFC 3227 (1 = most volatile).

incident.summary: EDR flags malware (invoice_Q4.pdf.exe) on WS-0142 beaconing to 45.155.205.233. The same IP brute-forced and logged in as jdoe, who then cleared the DC01 Security log.

prep_playbook.desc: Maintain IR plan, contact list, jump kit and tested playbooks

triage_alert.desc: Triage the EDR alert and correlate it with SIEM data

declare_incident.desc: Declare an incident, assign an incident commander, open a case

capture_netconns.desc: Live response: record running processes, ARP cache and network connections

capture_memory.desc: Capture a RAM image of WS-0142 and hash it (SHA-256)

collect_temp.desc: Collect the pagefile, swap and temp files

image_disk.desc: Forensic disk image through a write blocker and hash it

pull_siem_logs.desc: Export firewall/SIEM/DC logs for the incident window and hash them

copy_usb_unhashed.desc: Copy suspicious files to a personal USB stick to look at later
copy_usb_unhashed.anti_pattern: No hash, no write blocker, personal media: chain of custody is broken

scope_analysis.desc: Scope the incident: find every affected host and account

legal_hold.desc: Place a legal hold; notify legal/privacy counsel

isolate_host.desc: Network-isolate WS-0142 via EDR (power stays ON)

disable_account.desc: Disable jdoe and revoke all sessions/tokens

block_ioc.desc: Block the IOC IP/domain at the firewall and DNS

power_off.desc: Pull the power plug on WS-0142
power_off.anti_pattern: Destroys volatile evidence (RAM, network state, temp files)

remove_persistence.desc: Remove malware and persistence; patch the exploited weakness

reset_creds.desc: Reset credentials for every exposed account (incl. service accounts)

reimage.desc: Reimage WS-0142 from the golden image

restore_service.desc: Return WS-0142 to service; restore user data from known-good backup

monitor.desc: Heightened monitoring for re-infection for 30 days

lessons.desc: Lessons-learned review: update playbooks and controls, write the final report
